label: Intl Format
description: Locale-aware formatting nodes built on the browser's Intl APIs — no dependencies, no network. Relative Time turns a date into "3 hours ago" with an optional auto-refresh interval; Format Number handles decimal, currency and percent styles; Format List joins items with a localized conjunction or disjunction; Pluralize picks the right one/other form with Intl.PluralRules. Every node has a Locale input defaulting to the browser language, and every input is guarded — an unconnected input yields an empty string instead of throwing.
